description: Backend agent API (Node 22 + Express 4): package scaffold, config/log/errors/sse/curated foundation, pluggable store (memory/file/upstash), the full agent pipeline (input, sources, Tavily, draft/verify LLM, postprocess, runPipeline), the HTTP composition (middleware chain, routes, createApp, server), and the complete vitest+supertest suite. Depends on FEAT-001 (shared schema + sync). Covers ACs 4-13 (and 23/25 once FEAT-005 writes render.yaml/.env.example — see note). Includes design-review findings #2 (guide normalization) and #3 (repair-retry flow) plus the relevant NIT fixes.
steps: Scaffold the package: backend/package.json ("type":"module", engines node >=20.3 <23, EXACT deps/devDeps and scripts from design.md 'Backend (backend/package.json)'), backend/.npmrc (save-exact=true), backend/tsconfig.json (NodeNext, target ES2022, strict, rootDir src, outDir dist, skipLibCheck, include ['src']), backend/vitest.config.ts (environment node, include ['test/**/*.test.ts']). Run `node scripts/sync-shared.mjs` then `npm --prefix backend install` to generate backend/package-lock.json.

Foundation modules under backend/src/: config.ts (zod env parse; blank->undefined pre-pass; fatal process.exit(1) on invalid; export CONFIG_KEYS = the 17 env names; llmConfigured/searchConfigured; localhost-only-in-production warn), log.ts (JSON-lines logger filtered by LOG_LEVEL; never logs keys/headers/content/prompts/guides), errors.ts (ServerErrorCode incl. CLIENT_GONE, AgentError, toWire), sse.ts (openSse->SseWriter with the four SSE headers, flushHeaders, 15s heartbeat, buildMeta helper), curated.ts (CuratedIndex: bySlug, byKey from slug/name/aliases, summaries, match(key), officialDomainsFor(key); GuideSchema.parse every guide at boot, fatal on failure).

Store layer under backend/src/store/: types.ts (GuideStore interface), memoryStore.ts, fileStore.ts (atomic *.tmp+rename, promise-chain mutex for cache.json/recent.json, corrupt-file -> warn+empty, expired cache ignored on read), upstashStore.ts (takes an injected minimal Redis-like {get,set,lpush,ltrim,lrange}; real @upstash/redis Redis built only inside createStore), index.ts (createStore(config,log); STORE=auto picks upstash iff creds else file; STORE=upstash with no creds is FATAL per NIT). Every get() does GuideSchema.safeParse and returns null (warn) on failure.

Agent pipeline under backend/src/agent/: input.ts (normalizeAppInput 6 rules — control-char reject FIRST; single validation message 'Enter a public app name or developer docs URL (max 200 characters).' per NIT), sources.ts (registrableDomain, GENERIC_TOKENS, brandTokens, classifySource), tavily.ts (search/extract via global fetch, AbortSignal.any([signal, AbortSignal.timeout(ms)]) with 15s/30s, the HTTP->SEARCH_FAILED mapping, non-JSON/missing results -> empty), draftSchema.ts (GuideDraftSchema + VerificationSchema strict-mode exactly as written in design.md), prompts.ts (system+user prompts; sources declared untrusted), llm.ts (createLlm(client,model,log)->{draft,verify}; export DraftInvalid; import LengthFinishReasonError/ContentFilterFinishReasonError from 'openai/error'; per-request timeout 50_000 draft/repair, 40_000 verify; OpenAI error-class mapping), postprocess.ts (normalizeDraft 8 rules, slugify, assembleGuide, clampToSchemaLimits), pipeline.ts (runPipeline 7 stages resolve/search/read/draft/verify/assemble/save; emits only step/source/guide).

Fold design-review finding #2 into postprocess.ts: before GuideSchema validation convert null OR empty-after-trim optional strings to undefined (zod .optional() rejects ''); add a normalizeVerification pass (trim fields, drop empty array items, empty note -> undefined); the confidence note is the verifier's note when the verifier LOWERED the confidence level, otherwise the draft's note; PREPEND pipeline notes to verification.uncertain BEFORE truncating that list to 15 items.

Fold design-review finding #3 into pipeline.ts/postprocess.ts: after each draft attempt validate by running an assembleGuide(verification:null) PROBE; repair AT MOST once (re-emit the 'draft' step as active with a detail message describing the repair); run verification EXACTLY once; if final assembly still fails emit LLM_FAILED without further retry; export DraftInvalid so the pipeline catches it via instanceof and never lets it escape runPipeline.

HTTP composition: backend/src/middleware/{cors,rateLimit,concurrency,errorHandler,asyncHandler}.ts; backend/src/routes/{health,guides,generate}.ts; backend/src/app.ts (createApp(deps): trust proxy, disable x-powered-by, helmet cross-origin, corsMiddleware, routes, JSON 404, errorHandler; no compression); backend/src/server.ts (parse config, build real deps from tavily.ts/llm.ts, construct the single OpenAI client only when llmConfigured, build stub LLM/search deps that throw CONFIG_MISSING when keys are missing so /api/generate streams a clean error per NIT, SIGTERM graceful close, unhandledRejection log-only, uncaughtException exit 1).

generate.ts route = the 7-middleware chain exactly as design.md 'POST /api/generate': express.json({limit:'2kb'}) -> validateBody (zod .strict() + normalizeAppInput; generate requestId) -> asyncHandler(shortCircuit) (curated/cache hit writes full SSE and ends) -> requireConfig (503 CONFIG_MISSING) -> acquireSlot (synchronous tryAcquire else 503 BUSY; res.once('close') release) -> limiter (express-rate-limit draft-7; handler releases slot then 429 with Retry-After) -> asyncHandler(runGeneration) (one AbortController per request; 120s timeout->TIMEOUT; res 'close'->CLIENT_GONE; classify(err,signal) checks signal.aborted first; finally clearTimeout+sse.end+releaseSlot). guides.ts validates GET /api/guides/:slug response and store.listRecent output against the zod schemas per NIT. health.ts exposes rateLimitMax in the JSON per NIT.

Write the full test suite under backend/test/: curated, input, postprocess, draftSchema, errors, pipeline, routes, sources, llm, fileStore, upstashStore, and deployFiles (all *.test.ts) exactly per design.md 'Testing strategy'. Add unit tests for the finding #2 normalization rules and the finding #3 repair-retry assertions (draft receives repairIssues:null first then a non-empty array; invalid twice -> LLM_FAILED; verifier-throws -> still a guide). NOTE: deployFiles.test.ts asserts against render.yaml/.env.example which FEAT-005 creates; FEAT-005 is ordered before the final convergence loop, so keep that test written here and it goes green in FEAT-005. If running the suite before FEAT-005 exists, it is acceptable for only deployFiles to fail; every other backend test MUST pass in this feature.
acceptance_criteria: `npm --prefix backend install` exits 0 and writes backend/package-lock.json with the exact pinned versions from design.md.
`npm --prefix backend run build` exits 0 (tsc, zero errors).

`npm --prefix backend test` passes every test except deployFiles (which passes after FEAT-005). This covers GET /api/health shape incl. rateLimitMax (AC 4), guides list/detail/404/400 (AC 5), generate 400 INVALID_INPUT cases + '  Asana  ' accepted (AC 6), 503 CONFIG_MISSING (AC 7), SSE content-type + meta->step->guide->done order with a schema-valid guide (AC 8), 429 after limit with Retry-After and cached/curated not counted (AC 9), CORS allow/deny (AC 10), verifier-fail/NO_SOURCES/TIMEOUT/abort pipeline cases (AC 11), post-process index-99 drop + foreign consoleUrl null (AC 12), cache-hit second request returns cached:true without the pipeline (AC 13).
normalizeDraft converts null/empty-after-trim optional strings to undefined and unit tests prove each rule (finding #2).
The pipeline runs at most one repair retry, runs verification exactly once, and emits LLM_FAILED when final assembly still fails, with tests asserting it (finding #3).
verification: npm --prefix backend test passes all tests except deployFiles (deployFiles goes green in FEAT-005)
findings:
DONE 2026-10. Backend scaffolded and all 4 verification commands pass: `node scripts/sync-shared.mjs` exit 0; `npm --prefix backend run build` exit 0 (tsc clean); `npm --prefix backend test` = 111 passing, ONLY the 4 deployFiles tests fail (they assert render.yaml/.env.example which FEAT-005 creates — expected, goes green there). NOT committed (workflow policy: work directly in repo, no commit/push).

INSTALL QUIRK (IMPORTANT for later features): `npm --prefix backend install` CRASHES on this machine with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading spec)' in arborist reify:save (npm 10.9.4 + --prefix bug, npm/cli#3256). WORKAROUND: run npm from INSIDE the package dir (cwd=backend) e.g. `npm install --no-audit --no-fund`. The lockfile was written this way with exact pinned versions. Use cwd-based install (not --prefix) for frontend/submission too.

BACKEND API SURFACE (for FEAT-004 frontend + FEAT-005 deploy):
- GET /api/health -> 200 { status:'ok', uptimeSec, version:'1.0.0', store, llmConfigured, searchConfigured, rateLimitMax, time }. Dependency-free (fast for Render/UptimeRobot). rateLimitMax IS exposed (AC 4 + NIT).
- GET /api/guides -> { curated: GuideSummary[], recent: GuideSummary[] }. store error -> recent:[] + 200.
- GET /api/guides/:slug -> 200 Guide (Cache-Control public,max-age=300); 400 INVALID_SLUG on bad slug (regex ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$ len<=80); 404 NOT_FOUND; 503 STORE_UNAVAILABLE on store throw. Curated checked before store.
- POST /api/generate -> 7-middleware chain: express.json(limit 2kb) -> validateBody (zod .strict() {app:string, force?:boolean=false} + normalizeAppInput; 400 INVALID_INPUT; generates res.locals.requestId via nanoid 12) -> shortCircuit (curated/cache hit writes full SSE meta/step/guide{cached:true,persisted:true}/done and ends; skipped when force) -> requireConfig (503 CONFIG_MISSING) -> acquireSlot (sync tryAcquire else 503 BUSY + Retry-After 30) -> limiter (express-rate-limit draft-7; handler releases slot then 429 RATE_LIMITED + numeric Retry-After header + body.retryAfterSec) -> runGeneration (SSE: meta first, pipeline emits step/source/guide, done last; 120s AbortController TIMEOUT; res 'close' -> CLIENT_GONE silent; classify() checks signal.aborted first; finally clearTimeout+sse.end+releaseSlot).
- Pre-stream errors: JSON { error:{ code, message, retryAfterSec? } } (ApiErrorBody). Once SSE open, errors are an 'error' event then 'done'.
- SSE wire protocol EXACTLY matches shared/schema.ts StreamEvent union. openSse sets the 4 headers (text/event-stream; no-cache,no-transform; keep-alive; X-Accel-Buffering:no), writes 'retry: 0', 15s heartbeat ': ping'. send() format: `id:<seq>\nevent:<e>\ndata:<json>\n\n`.

STORE KINDS (createStore(config,log) in store/index.ts): 'memory' | 'file' | 'upstash'. STORE=auto -> upstash iff both UPSTASH creds else file. STORE=upstash with no creds is FATAL (throws). GuideStore interface: get(slug):Guide|null (every impl GuideSchema.safeParse -> null+warn on failure), put(guide), listRecent(limit):GuideSummary[] newest-first, getCache(key):slug|null, setCache(key,slug,ttlSec). upstashStore takes an injected RedisLike {get,set,lpush,ltrim,lrange}; real @upstash/redis Redis built only in createStore. file store: atomic tmp+rename, promise-chain mutex for cache.json/recent.json, corrupt file -> warn+empty, expired cache ignored, DATA_DIR default ./.data (gitignored, ephemeral on Render).

CONFIG (config.ts): CONFIG_KEYS = the 17 env names (PORT, NODE_ENV, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_MODEL, TAVILY_API_KEY, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN, STORE, DATA_DIR, RATE_LIMIT_MAX, RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS, MAX_CONCURRENT_GENERATIONS, GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS, CACHE_TTL_HOURS, TRUST_PROXY, LOG_LEVEL). blank->undefined pre-pass; invalid value fatal process.exit(1); one Upstash var alone fatal; llmConfigured/searchConfigured flags; hasOnlyLocalhostOrigins() warns in production. CACHE_TTL_HOURS is converted to config.cacheTtlSec (hours*3600). deployFiles.test.ts (backend/test) expects backend/.env.example keys == CONFIG_KEYS exactly, render.yaml envVars >= those keys, exact strings 'cd backend && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build', 'cd backend && npm start', 'healthCheckPath: /api/health', and no sk-/tvly- shaped secrets. FEAT-005 MUST satisfy all of these.

DESIGN-REVIEW FINDINGS IMPLEMENTED: #2 normalization (normalizeDraft 8 rules + normalizeVerification: trim/drop-empty/empty-note->undefined; confidence note = verifier's note only when verifier LOWERED the level; pipeline notes PREPENDED to verification.uncertain before truncating to 15). #3 repair-retry (assembleGuide(verification:null) PROBE after each draft; repair AT MOST once re-emitting 'draft' active with detail; verify runs EXACTLY once; final assembly fail -> LLM_FAILED no further retry; DraftInvalid caught via instanceof, never escapes runPipeline). NIT fixes: single OpenAI client maxRetries:1 + per-request timeout 50000 draft/40000 verify; LengthFinishReasonError/ContentFilterFinishReasonError imported from 'openai/error'; limiter casts (req as AugmentedRequest).rateLimit; buildMeta shared; monogram=key.slice(0,2).toUpperCase(); health exposes rateLimitMax; stub LLM/search deps throw CONFIG_MISSING so /api/generate streams clean error when keys missing.

DEVIATION/NOTE: shared GuideSchema exports no `Confidence` TYPE (only the zod enum VALUE). postprocess.ts defines `type Confidence = keyof typeof CONFIDENCE_RANK` locally. llm.ts exports an LlmClient interface (beta.chat.completions.parse only) so tests inject a stub; createOpenAiClient() builds the real one. tavily.ts exports createTavily(apiKey)->{search,extract}; server.ts wires real deps or CONFIG_MISSING stubs. slugify follows design literally: NFKD then [^a-z0-9]+ -> '-', so 'Café Déjà' -> 'cafe-de-ja' (combining marks become separators) — documented in postprocess.test.ts.
